name: Project context: attach two documents to an agent and reorder them by drag and drop
description: Opens the seeded agent `Test Quality Reviewer`, switches to its Context tab, attaches specs/alpha.md then specs/beta.md, drags beta's row above alpha's, reloads and asserts the order persisted (beta before alpha). jsdom cannot verify real HTML5 drag and drop, so this is the only coverage of AC-21. PRECONDITION: the repo `acme/payments-api` has a clone holding specs/alpha.md and specs/beta.md — scripts/e2e.sh and e2e-web.yml copy e2e/fixtures/repos into a throwaway dir and point DEVDIGEST_CLONE_DIR at it before the API starts — and the agent is the one `pnpm db:seed` writes. The flow WRITES (it attaches documents to the seeded agent), like 10-conventions, which is why it sorts after it. Drag variant shipped: the native `agent-browser drag` command (CDP mouse drag) fires the HTML5 dragstart/dragover/drop events, so no eval-dispatched DragEvent fallback is used.

steps.label: the agent editor's tab strip rendered (a Context button exists)
switch to the agent's Context tab
the fixture clone's documents are listed
alpha is attached (its reorder handle is enabled)
beta is attached (its reorder handle is enabled)
before the drag alpha sits above beta
leave and come back to force a fresh fetch
tab strip rendered after the reload
switch to the Context tab again

cmd: (l => { const a = l.findIndex(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Reorder specs/alpha.md'); const b = l.findIndex(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Reorder specs/beta.md'); return b >= 0 && a >= 0 && b < a; })([...document.querySelectorAll("button[aria-label^='Reorder ']")])
steps.label: the persisted order has beta before alpha
